headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HUL (12)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix from pole position, 12.6s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Nico Hulkenberg made the biggest climb, from P18 to P9.
Isack Hadjar had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P17.
The stewards penalised LAW (5 second time penalty), TSU (5 second time penalty), ALB (5 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty), STR (5 second time penalty) and BEA (5 second time penalty).
There were 27 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 2 points over Max Verstappen.
